WITH daily AS (
  SELECT service_date, SUM(trips) AS trips
  FROM trips_daily
  WHERE year(service_date) = 2025
  GROUP BY service_date
)
SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(trips) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS avg_trips_per_day,
  COUNT(*) AS days_with_data,
  SUM(trips) AS total_trips_2025
FROM daily
notes: Assumes the average is over the service dates that have data in 2025 (total 2025 trips divided by the number of days with trip records), with the total also shown; dividing by 365 instead would only differ if some days are missing.

sql:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT year(service_date) AS yr, SUM(trips) AS trips
  FROM trips_daily
  WHERE year(service_date) IN (2024, 2025)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2025 THEN trips END) - SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2024 THEN trips END))
        / SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2024 THEN trips END), 1) AS trips_pct_change
FROM t
notes: Assumes trips are compared as full calendar-year totals from trips_daily for 2024 vs 2025, and the percent change is (2025 − 2024) / 2024.

sql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT SUM(complaints) AS complaints
  FROM complaints_daily
  WHERE year(opened_date) = 2024
),
t AS (
  SELECT SUM(trips) AS trips
  FROM trips_daily
  WHERE year(service_date) = 2024
)
SELECT ROUND(1000.0 * c.complaints / t.trips, 1) AS complaint_rate_per_1000
